item.title: Saint Vincent de Paul Church in Girardville Set to Close in January 2026
item.description: Parishioners at Saint Vincent de Paul Church in Girardville learned Sunday morning that the worship site will officially close early next year, marking the end of more than a century of Catholic presence at the location.
